lines.en: label makotodorm25:
I knock on Makoto’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Makoto 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: scene tree3
scene bluejayredux1
She appears.
lines.zh: 她出现了。

lines.en: : Good evening, Sensei. To what do I owe the pleasure?
lines.zh: : 晚上好，老师。什么风把你吹来了？

lines.en: : You owe nothing at all, Makoto. I’m just here to say hello to my favorite class representative.
lines.zh: : 你不欠我什么，Makoto。我只是来跟我最喜欢的班长打个招呼。

lines.en: : And also the only class representative you have.
lines.zh: : 也就是你唯一的班长。

lines.en: : Correct. But my opinion would not change even if {i}everyone{/i} was a class representative.
lines.zh: : 没错。不过就算{i}每个人{/i}都是班长，我的看法也不会变。

lines.en: : Likely story.
lines.zh: : 说得跟真的似的。

lines.en: : Anyway, I’m glad you showed up when you did.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我很高兴你来得正是时候。

lines.en: : I was about to embark on a little...journey. And I’d feel much more comfortable if you were there with me.
lines.zh: : 我正打算踏上一段小小的……旅程。而如果你陪着我，我会舒服很多。

lines.en: : A journey? What kind of journey are we talking about?
lines.zh: : 旅程？什么样的旅程？

lines.en: scene bluejayredux2
: Let’s just say I’m in the mood to do something...bad.
lines.zh: : 就这么说吧，我有心情干点……坏事。

lines.en: : You’re not planning on robbing a convenience store or murdering anyone, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会是打算抢劫便利店或者杀人之类的吧？

lines.en: : {i}Worse...{/i}
: I’m planning on sneaking into[school].
lines.zh: : 我打算溜进[school]。

lines.en: : You sick bastard.
lines.zh: : 你这个恶心的混蛋。

lines.en: : Why, though?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？

lines.en: scene bluejayredux3
: Well, remember how you’ve found me on the roof a few times now?
lines.zh: : 嗯，还记得你已经有好几次在屋顶上找到我了吗？

lines.en: : Vaguely. That sounds like a thing that probably happened.
lines.zh: : 隐约记得。听起来像是发生过的事。

lines.en: : Well, it’s become a bit of a...happy place for me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那儿已经成了我的一个……快乐的地方。

lines.en: : I go there when I need to think and, sooner or later, I find myself calming down.
lines.zh: : 我需要思考的时候就去那儿，迟早我会发现自己平静下来。

lines.en: : It’s no different than somewhere like a lake or a...peaceful mountain top. Just a lot less...{i}serene.{/i}
lines.zh: : 跟湖边或者……宁静的山顶之类的地方没什么不同。只是没那么……{i}静谧{/i}。

lines.en: : You obviously don’t have to come if you’re afraid of breaking a few rules.
lines.zh: : 如果你怕违反几条规定的话，你显然不必跟来。

lines.en: : But knowing that you care less about rules than you care about the melting of our polar ice caps, I assume you’ll be tagging along. Yes?
lines.zh: : 不过既然我知道你在乎规定远不如在乎我们极地冰盖的融化，我猜你会跟着来。对吧？

lines.en: : Hold on, why do you just assume I don’t care about the polar ice caps? That’s a weird assumption.
lines.zh: : 等等，你凭什么就假定我不在乎极地冰盖？这假设真怪。

lines.en: scene bluejayredux1
: Was I {i}incorrect{/i} in assuming that?
lines.zh: : 我这个假定{i}错{/i}了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, no. I honestly don't care at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，没有。我是真的完全不在乎。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 就是嘛。

lines.en: : Come along with me then. I have a key to the roof, so it'll be less of a break-in and more of just...trespassing.
lines.zh: : 那就跟我来吧。我有屋顶的钥匙，所以这与其说是破门而入，不如说只是……擅闯。

lines.en: : Is it even trespassing if you have a key?
lines.zh: : 有钥匙还叫擅闯吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure. But if we wind up getting caught, I’ll be sure to ask.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。不过万一我们被抓了，我一定替你问问。

lines.en: : You do that, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你就去问吧，Makoto。

lines.en: scene black
The two of us walk down the same streets we’ve walked hundreds, if not thousands of times before.
lines.zh: 我俩走在那些我们已经走过几百次、甚至几千次的街道上。

lines.en: Not together, obviously. But as ourselves.
lines.zh: 显然不是一起走的。是作为各自的自己走的。

lines.en: Makoto and I will never go anywhere thousands of times together.
lines.zh: Makoto 和我永远不会一起走几千次。

lines.en: Something like that just wouldn’t make sense.
lines.zh: 那种事根本讲不通。

lines.en: There’s no way around saying this, but she’s simply too good for me.
lines.zh: 这话没法绕开说，但她对我来说就是太好了。

lines.en: The more time I spend with her, though-
lines.zh: 不过我越是跟她待在一起——

lines.en: The more I realize that there’s some sort of darkness growing within her.
lines.zh: 就越发现她心里长出某种黑暗。

lines.en: Is that darkness due to me?
lines.zh: 那份黑暗是因为我吗？

lines.en: Did I plant the seed?
lines.zh: 是我种下的种子吗？

lines.en: And will that seed consume her?
lines.zh: 而那颗种子会把她吞噬吗？

lines.en: Will vines sprout from deep within her body and twist around her entrails?
lines.zh: 藤蔓会从她身体深处抽芽，缠住她的内脏吗？

lines.en: Will they lift her up or pull her down?
lines.zh: 它们会把她托起来，还是拽下去？

lines.en: Will they make it harder for her to function as the diligent and responsible girl she is meant to be?
lines.zh: 它们会不会让她更难当一个她本该成为的那种勤勉负责的女孩？

lines.en: Or will she find a way to cut all of that out of her and draw the light back in to where it once called home?
lines.zh: 还是她会想办法把那些全都从体内剜掉，把光重新引回它曾经称之为家的地方？

lines.en: scene nightsky
I’m sorry.
lines.zh: 对不起。

lines.en: I’m feeling particularly callous tonight.
lines.zh: 我今晚格外冷血。

lines.en: And the fact that we’re surrounded by silence is only making me more aware of it.
lines.zh: 而周围这片寂静，只是让我更清楚地意识到这一点。

lines.en: Quiet.
lines.zh: 安静。

lines.en: Quiet.
lines.zh: 安静。

lines.en: Quiet.
lines.zh: 安静。

lines.en: Everything is so quiet.
lines.zh: 一切都这么安静。

lines.en: Say something.
lines.zh: 说点什么吧。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: {i}Thank you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}谢谢。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah? What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Have you ever gone to[school] after dark before?
lines.zh: : 你以前天黑之后去过[school]吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. With Maya.
lines.zh: : 去过。跟 Maya。

lines.en: : Wait, {i}Maya?{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}Maya{/i}？

lines.en: : Why on Earth would it have been with her? That doesn’t make any sense at all.
lines.zh: : 究竟为什么会是跟她？这完全说不通啊。

lines.en: : She needed help carrying something.
lines.zh: : 她需要人帮忙搬东西。

lines.en: : To[school]? In the middle of the night?
lines.zh: : 搬到[school]？大半夜的？

lines.en: : I don’t really get it either, but I’ve stopped questioning her actions. I'm pretty sure she's insane.
lines.zh: : 我也搞不太懂，但我已经不去质疑她的行为了。我挺确定她疯了。

lines.en: : Well...shit. Here I was thinking I’d get to be the first one to embark on a rebellious delinquent-style journey with you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……操。我还以为我能成为第一个跟你踏上这种不良少年式反叛旅程的人呢。

lines.en: : If this is your idea of what delinquents do, it’s a bit off.
lines.zh: : 如果这就是你心目中不良少年干的事，那有点跑偏了。

lines.en: : Someone like Yumi wouldn’t be caught dead sneaking {i}into{/i}[school].
lines.zh: : Yumi 那种人死也不会溜{i}进{/i}[school]。

lines.en: : You certainly have a strange way of being rebellious, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你的反叛方式真够奇怪的，Makoto。

lines.en: : Hah. I suppose I do.
lines.zh: : 哈。我想是的。

lines.en: : But you’ll have to forgive me since my mind isn’t all {i}here{/i} tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过你得原谅我，因为我今晚心思不太在{i}这儿{/i}。

lines.en: : Thinking about your dad again?
lines.zh: : 又在想你爸？

lines.en: scene bluejay1
: Perhaps.
lines.zh: : 也许是。

lines.en: : I’ve been thinking about a lot of things.
lines.zh: : 我在想很多事。

lines.en: : In fact, I’ve barely been studying at all lately.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我最近几乎都没怎么学习。

lines.en: : Ever since Halloween, I’ve been slacking off.
lines.zh: : 从万圣节之后，我就一直在摸鱼。

lines.en: : It’s like you planted some sort of seed inside of me.
lines.zh: : 就像你在我体内种下了某种种子。

lines.en: : It’s consuming my normal routines.
lines.zh: : 它在吞噬我正常的日常。

lines.en: : Turning me into a {i}slacker.{/i}
lines.zh: : 把我变成一个{i}懒虫{/i}。

lines.en: scene bluejay2
: Just kidding~
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的～

lines.en: : I’m just a little tired, is all.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点累，就这样。

lines.en: : Tired of giving 100%% all of the time and getting like 4%% back in return.
lines.zh: : 受够了每次都付出 100%，却只收回 4%。

lines.en: : So, in order to make up for my awesome overexertion of power, I’m taking a bit of a...vacation, if you will.
lines.zh: : 所以，为了补偿我那了不起的能量透支，我要休个小……假，可以这么说。

lines.en: : And the first stop on said vacation is the roof of the[school]?
lines.zh: : 而这趟假期的第一站是[school]的屋顶？

lines.en: scene bluejay3
: This isn’t just the roof of the[school], though.
lines.zh: : 不过这不只是[school]的屋顶。

lines.en: : It’s the top of the world.
lines.zh: : 这是世界的顶端。

lines.en: : You can see everything from here.
lines.zh: : 从这儿你什么都能看到。

lines.en: : You can see my house...You can see the dorms....You can probably even see over the barrier if you're tall enough.
lines.zh: : 你能看到我家……你能看到宿舍……如果你够高，大概连那道屏障外面都能看到。

lines.en: : You mean like, outside of Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你是说，Kumon-mi 外面？

lines.en: : What else would I mean?
lines.zh: : 不然我还能指什么？

lines.en: : That’s...a good question.
lines.zh: : 那……倒是个好问题。

lines.en: : Remember when we were able to leave, Sensei? Before the stupid space war started and whisked my dad and everybody else away?
lines.zh: : 还记得我们还能出去的时候吗，老师？在那场愚蠢的太空战争开始、把我爸和其他所有人卷走之前？

lines.en: : You’re lucky you got to stay.
lines.zh: : 你运气好，留下来了。

lines.en: : And I guess, by association, I’m kind of lucky too.
lines.zh: : 而我想，因为沾了你的光，我也算有点运气。

lines.en: scene bluejay4
: The two of us might bicker constantly, but I want you to know that you really are important to me.
lines.zh: : 我俩也许老是拌嘴，但我想让你知道，你对我来说真的很重要。

lines.en: : What’s this all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然说这个？

lines.en: : I think it’s called “having a moment.” You should probably just let it happen so I don’t feel awkward about spilling my feelings out in front of you.
lines.zh: : 我想这叫「来感觉了」。你大概就让它发生吧，免得我在你面前倒感情时觉得尴尬。

lines.en: : You do know I care about-
lines.zh: : 你知道我在乎——

lines.en: scene bluejay5
: I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : Even if you make it really hard to believe sometimes...I know.
lines.zh: : 哪怕有时候你让人很难相信……我知道。

lines.en: : And the more we talk, the more I see those feelings of yours growing.
lines.zh: : 而且我们聊得越多，我就越看到你那些感情在生长。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I feel like you’ve become a different person entirely.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我觉得你整个人都变成了另一个人。

lines.en: : Funny, huh?
lines.zh: : 好笑吧？

lines.en: : You’re pretty different now from when I met you as well, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你跟我刚认识你的时候比起来，也挺不一样了，Makoto。

lines.en: I obviously don't know what the true beginning was like when {i}I{/i} met Makoto-
lines.zh: 我显然不知道{i}我{/i}最初遇见 Makoto 时是什么样子——

lines.en: But she’s definitely changed a bit from when I assumed this role.
lines.zh: 但她从我接下这个身份以来确实变了不少。

lines.en: The old Makoto would never retreat to the top of {s}the world{/s} the[school] in the middle of the night like this.
lines.zh: 以前的 Makoto 绝不会像这样在深夜遁到[school]这处{s}世界{/s}之巅。

lines.en: : Like I said, you planted a seed in me.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，你在我体内种下了一颗种子。

lines.en: : And maybe it's unrelated...Maybe it's not.
lines.zh: : 也许跟那有关……也许无关。

lines.en: : But I’m breaking now, and a certain {i}somebody{/i} is going to have to pick up the pieces.
lines.zh: : 但我现在正在碎裂，而{i}某个人{/i}得来收拾这些碎片。

lines.en: : Why do you say you’re breaking?
lines.zh: : 你为什么说自己在碎裂？

lines.en: : It’s not uncommon to go through periods of time where darkness feels inescapable.
lines.zh: : 人都会经历那种黑暗似乎无处可逃的时期，这并不罕见。

lines.en: : And if that’s what’s happening to you right now, you just...need to find some more light to bring things back to the correct color.
lines.zh: : 如果那正是你现在经历的，你只需要……找更多的光，把一切调回正确的颜色。

lines.en: : The correct color, huh?
lines.zh: : 正确的颜色，是吧？

lines.en: scene bluejay6
: What color is your life, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你的人生是什么颜色的，老师？

lines.en: : If you had to paint the world one color, which one would you make it?
lines.zh: : 如果你必须把世界涂成一种颜色，你会选哪种？

lines.en: What I want to say is that I wouldn’t paint it at all.
lines.zh: 我想说的是，我根本不会去涂它。

lines.en: Despite all of the horrible colors in this world and how none of them seem to stand out to me, changing them would probably make things even worse.
lines.zh: 尽管这世上有那么多糟糕的颜色，尽管它们在我眼里没有哪一个显得突出，但改变它们大概只会让事情更糟。

lines.en: No one wants to live in a vibrant paradise.
lines.zh: 没人想住在一个鲜艳的天堂里。

lines.en: No one wants happiness to fall off of a tree like it's some sort of fruit.
lines.zh: 没人想让幸福像果子一样从树上掉下来。

lines.en: We want misery- because it’s the only way we can ever feel like we’re getting anywhere.
lines.zh: 我们想要痛苦——因为那是我们唯一能感觉到自己在往前走的方式。

lines.en: I will lie to this girl.
lines.zh: 我要对这姑娘撒谎。

lines.en: : Blue.
lines.zh: : 蓝色。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Blue is my color, too.
lines.zh: : 蓝色也是我的颜色。

lines.en: : My eyes are blue. My bra is blue. My diary is blue.
lines.zh: : 我的眼睛是蓝的。我的胸罩是蓝的。我的日记本是蓝的。

lines.en: : Everything is blue.
lines.zh: : 一切都是蓝的。

lines.en: : Everything will always be blue.
lines.zh: : 一切永远都会是蓝的。

lines.en: : Okay, I'm starting to think you may like the color blue a {i}bit{/i} more than I do.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我开始觉得你也许比我更喜欢蓝色{i}一点{/i}。

lines.en: scene bluejay7
: Hahaha! Probably.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！大概吧。

lines.en: scene bluejay8
: Wanna try and take a guess at what my favorite animal is?
lines.zh: : 想猜猜我最喜欢的动物是什么吗？

lines.en: : I’m going to go out on a limb here and say it’s a bluejay.
lines.zh: : 我大胆猜一下：蓝松鸦。

lines.en: : You’re so smart.
lines.zh: : 你真聪明。

lines.en: : I had plenty of hints.
lines.zh: : 提示够多了。

lines.en: scene black
Makoto turns around and begins to climb up a ladder attached to the part of the building we came up through.
lines.zh: Makoto 转过身，开始爬一架架在我们上来的那部分建筑上的梯子。

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei, you know how I said we’re at the top of the world a few minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 嘿，老师，还记得我几分钟前说我们在世界之巅吗？

lines.en: : Well, do you want to see the {i}top{/i} of the top of the world?
lines.zh: : 那么，你想看看世界之巅的{i}顶端{/i}吗？

lines.en: : I’ve always been afraid to go up this high, but I’m in the mood to take a bit of a leap of faith tonight.
lines.zh: : 我一直怕爬这么高，但今晚我有心情来一次信仰之跃。

lines.en: : Probably not something you should say when you’re climbing to the top of a building.
lines.zh: : 爬到楼顶的时候大概不该说这种话。

lines.en: : Heheh~ No. Probably not.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿～ 对。大概不该。

lines.en: : Are you going to come, though? Or are you going to stay down there like a loser?
lines.zh: : 不过你来不来？还是你就要像个输家一样待在下面？

lines.en: : No one calls me a loser and gets away with it.
lines.zh: : 没人叫我输家还能全身而退。

lines.en: I follow behind Makoto and move up the ladder.
lines.zh: 我跟在 Makoto 后面往上爬。

lines.en: She climbs very slowly despite her voice sounding confident and unwavering just seconds ago.
lines.zh: 尽管她几秒前听起来自信又坚定，她爬得非常慢。

lines.en: Her legs are shaking.
lines.zh: 她的腿在抖。

lines.en: She must really be afraid of heights.
lines.zh: 她一定真的很怕高。

lines.en: What a coward.
lines.zh: 真是个胆小鬼。

lines.en: scene bluejay9
We make it to the top of the top of the world and bask in the light of the moon as we overlook our temporary prison.
lines.zh: 我们到了世界之巅的顶端，沐浴在月光里，俯瞰我们这座临时的牢笼。

lines.en: There is someone I know who would love this view.
lines.zh: 我认识的一个人会爱死这片景色。

lines.en: {s}CORRECTION NEEDED{/s}
lines.zh: {s}需要修正{/s}

lines.en: There is someone I know who loves this view.
lines.zh: 我认识的一个人爱这片景色。

lines.en: This is where she comes after the world ends.
lines.zh: 世界结束之后，她就来这儿。

lines.en: It’s where she resets it.
lines.zh: 她在这儿重置它。

lines.en: But tonight-
lines.zh: 但今晚——

lines.en: It’s just the roof of the[school].
lines.zh: 它就只是[school]的屋顶。

lines.en: : It’s even prettier than I imagined it would be up here...
lines.zh: : 这里比我原先想象的还要美……

lines.en: : I can’t say I particularly like being this high up, to tell you the truth.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我不太喜欢待在这么高的地方。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m absolutely horrified right now. But it’s worth all of that fear being able to look out at the city like this with you.
lines.zh: : 哦，我现在怕得要死。但能像这样跟你一起眺望这座城市，那些恐惧都值了。

lines.en: : You’re just trying to lower my guard so you can push me off, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你只是在想办法让我放松警惕，好把我推下去，对吧？

lines.en: scene bluejay10
: Hmm...I guess that would be appropriate revenge for all of the torment you’ve put me through.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想那算是对你施加在我身上的所有折磨恰当的报复。

lines.en: : I will not hesitate to push you off first if it really comes down to it.
lines.zh: : 如果真到那一步，我会毫不犹豫先把你推下去。

lines.en: scene bluejay11
: Somehow, I’m not surprised.
lines.zh: : 不知怎么，我并不意外。

lines.en: : You’ve always been the center of your own world.
lines.zh: : 你一直都是你自己那个世界的中心。

lines.en: : Not like there’s a problem with that or anything. I’m kind of the same way.
lines.zh: : 不是说那有什么问题什么的。我也有点这样。

lines.en: : The big difference in us, though, is that you willingly choose to put yourself first and I just do it instinctively.
lines.zh: : 不过我们之间最大的差别是：你是主动选择把自己放在第一位，而我是本能地这么做。

lines.en: : So what you’re saying is I’m an asshole and you’re just a victim of natural instinct.
lines.zh: : 所以你是在说我这人是混蛋，而你只是自然本能的受害者。

lines.en: scene bluejay12
: Precisely.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : I’m a better person than you are.
lines.zh: : 我比你更好。

lines.en: : I’m aware. Thank you for reminding me.
lines.zh: : 我知道。谢谢你提醒我。

lines.en: scene bluejay13
: There’s no need to thank me.
lines.zh: : 不用谢。

lines.en: : I think you’re actually really amazing when it comes down to it.
lines.zh: : 我想说到底你其实真的很了不起。

lines.en: : I mean, you’ve made it {i}how many{/i} years into life without giving up on anything?
lines.zh: : 我是说，你都活了{i}多少{/i}年了，却从没放弃过什么？

lines.en: : I’m not even out of [high_school] and I’m already rethinking my career choice because of how exhausted I am all the time.
lines.zh: : 我连[high_school]都还没毕业，就已经因为无时无刻的疲惫在重新考虑我的职业选择了。

lines.en: : And it doesn’t help that the only slightly-patriarchal figure in my life right now makes me do things like...jerk him off with a fake vagina.
lines.zh: : 而且，我生活里唯一那个稍微带点父权色彩的家伙，还让我干些……用假阴道给他打飞机之类的事，这也帮不上忙。

lines.en: scene bluejay14
: Oh, and just to clarify, that’s not an insult. I actually kind of liked doing that.
lines.zh: : 哦，先声明，那不是贬低。我其实还挺喜欢干那个的。

lines.en: : Which I guess might be part of the problem.
lines.zh: : 我想这大概也是问题的一部分。

lines.en: : Point is, I’ve gone long enough with no guidance. I officially give up.
lines.zh: : 重点是，我已经够久没有引导了。我正式放弃了。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : You heard me.
lines.zh: : 你听到了。

lines.en: : I give up.
lines.zh: : 我放弃。

lines.en: : Just like that?
lines.zh: : 就这么放弃了？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Are you really weak enough to give up just because you’re hitting a rough patch emotionally?
lines.zh: : 你真的脆弱到只因为情绪上遇到点坎坷就放弃？

lines.en: : You said it yourself that your problems pale in comparison to some of the other girls, so why do something so drastic all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你自己说过你的问题跟其他一些女孩比起来不值一提，那为什么突然做这么极端的事？

lines.en: scene bluejay15
: Oh?
: Is that the original Sensei coming back from his metaphorical grave to give me a reality check?
lines.zh: : 这是原本的那个 Sensei 从他隐喻的坟墓里爬出来，来给我一记现实检查吗？

lines.en: : If that’s what you want to call it, sure.
lines.zh: : 你想这么叫也行。

lines.en: : I just didn’t think you were this weak.
lines.zh: : 我只是没想到你这么软弱。

lines.en: scene bluejay16
: Is this some sort of secret teacher strategy- talking down about people at their weakest in order to get them to turn around?
lines.zh: : 这是某种秘密教学策略吗——在人最脆弱的时候贬低他们，好让他们转过身来？

lines.en: : It’s a strategy I made up just now. And it’s going to work.
lines.zh: : 是我刚刚才想出来的策略。而且它会管用。

lines.en: scene bluejay17
: It’s not, though.
lines.zh: : 不，它不会。

lines.en: : I’ve already figured out what I want to be instead.
lines.zh: : 我已经想清楚我要改成什么了。

lines.en: : It came to me for the first time just a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 几分钟前它第一次出现在我脑子里。

lines.en: : A few minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 几分钟前？

lines.en: : What were we even talking about a few minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 几分钟前我们到底在聊什么来着？

lines.en: : What’s your new career choice, Makoto? Please enlighten me.
lines.zh: : 你的新职业选择是什么，Makoto？请指教。

lines.en: scene bluejay18
: I want to be a bluejay.
lines.zh: : 我想当一只蓝松鸦。

lines.en: : Well, good luck with that. I can't name one person who has successfully turned into a bird.
lines.zh: : 行，祝你好运。我还说不出有谁成功变成过一只鸟。

lines.en: : Doesn’t it sound amazing being free from everything, though?
lines.zh: : 可听起来多棒啊——从一切里解脱出来。

lines.en: : No responsibility...No expectations...Nothing to keep you grounded.
lines.zh: : 没有责任……没有期待……没有任何东西把你拴在地上。

lines.en: : Nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有。

lines.en: : You just fly.
lines.zh: : 你只是飞。

lines.en: : It’s easy to escape from darkness when you can always move directly toward the sun or the moon.
lines.zh: : 当你随时能直接朝太阳或月亮飞去的时候，逃离黑暗很容易。

lines.en: : But for people like me who can’t seem to find happiness even when their situation isn’t all that bad to begin with, leaving the dark is impossible.
lines.zh: : 但对像我这样、就算处境本来没那么糟也找不到幸福的人来说，离开黑暗是不可能的。

lines.en: scene bluejay19
: It’s like...
lines.zh: : 就像……

lines.en: : There’s this...shadow always looming over me.
lines.zh: : 有那么一道……影子，总是悬在我头顶。

lines.en: : And when I go to sleep, it finds its way inside.
lines.zh: : 而我睡着的时候，它会找到路钻进来。

lines.en: : It sinks deep into my body and twists its shadowy fingers around my entrails.
lines.zh: : 它深深沉进我的身体，用它那些影子做的手指缠住我的内脏。

lines.en: : It’s killing me from within and no one even knows about it other than you.
lines.zh: : 它在从里面杀死我，而除了你没人知道。

lines.en: : But, if I were a bird-
lines.zh: : 可是，如果我是只鸟——

lines.en: : I could just...fly away.
lines.zh: : 我就可以……飞走。

lines.en: : Find something new.
lines.zh: : 去找点新的东西。

lines.en: scene bluejay20
: You’re familiar with Emily Dickinson, correct?
lines.zh: : 你熟悉艾米莉·狄金森吧？

lines.en: : I know you used to write quite a bit, but I don’t know if I ever got your thoughts on classical poets.
lines.zh: : 我知道你以前写过不少东西，但我不知道我有没有听过你对古典诗人的看法。

lines.en: : I’m familiar, yes.
lines.zh: : 熟悉，是的。

lines.en: : Do you know the one that goes...
lines.zh: : 你知道那首吗……

lines.en: : Hope is the thing with feathers-
lines.zh: : 希望是有羽毛的东西——

lines.en: : That perches in the soul-
lines.zh: : 栖息在灵魂里——

lines.en: : That sings the tune without the words-
lines.zh: : 唱着没有词的曲调——

lines.en: : And never stops at all...
lines.zh: : 而且永不停歇……

lines.en: : What do you think that poem means, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那首诗是什么意思，老师？

lines.en: : Who cares? Emily Dickinson spent virtually her entire life locked inside of her room. She’s not someone you should be stealing life lessons from.
lines.zh: : 谁在乎？艾米莉·狄金森几乎一辈子都把自己锁在房间里。你不该从她那儿偷人生教训。

lines.en: : Life’s not some sort of poem, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 人生不是什么诗，Makoto。

lines.en: scene bluejay21
: Oh, I know that better than anyone.
lines.zh: : 哦，我比谁都清楚这个。

lines.en: : Life’s far too ugly to even be close to a poem.
lines.zh: : 人生丑陋得连靠近一首诗都算不上。

lines.en: Is this really Makoto?
lines.zh: 这真的是 Makoto 吗？

lines.en: Where is any of this even coming from?
lines.zh: 这些到底是从哪儿冒出来的？

lines.en: Ever since I met her, she’s done nothing but give everyone and everything her all.
lines.zh: 从我认识她起，她做的一切就是为每个人、每件事倾尽所有。

lines.en: But now, out of seemingly nowhere, I’m forced to talk her back onto the path she’s meant to take.
lines.zh: 可现在，不知从哪儿冒出来，我被迫把她劝回她本该走的那条路上。

lines.en: But, then again-
lines.zh: 不过话说回来——

lines.en: These could all just be the ramblings of an upset [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: 这些也可能只是一个心烦意乱的[teenage]女孩的胡话。

lines.en: Plenty of people say things they don’t mean when overcome by emotions.
lines.zh: 很多人被情绪淹没时都会说些言不由衷的话。

lines.en: Just because Makoto is a lot more mature than everyone else doesn’t mean she’s exempt from that.
lines.zh: 就算 Makoto 比其他人成熟得多，也不代表她能免俗。

lines.en: Yeah.
lines.zh: 是啊。

lines.en: That’s all this is.
lines.zh: 就是这么回事。

lines.en: She was never serious about throwing her life away.
lines.zh: 她从来没有真的认真要把自己的人生扔掉。

lines.en: She’s just lashing out.
lines.zh: 她只是在发泄。

lines.en: And since she’s just lashing out- I should do what I always do.
lines.zh: 而既然她只是在发泄——我就该做我一直在做的事。

lines.en: Admit it’s not my problem and move on.
lines.zh: 承认那不是我的问题，然后走开。

lines.en: scene bluejay22
: See? You’re giving up too. That’s your patented “Not my problem” face.
lines.zh: : 看吧？你也在放弃。那就是你招牌的「不关我事」脸。

lines.en: : Stop knowing me so well. It's creepy.
lines.zh: : 别这么了解我。真瘆人。

lines.en: : I can’t. I’ve been watching you since the moment I laid eyes on you.
lines.zh: : 我办不到。从我第一眼看到你起，我就一直在看着你。

lines.en: : I even brought you to this extremely special place...to witness something extremely special with me.
lines.zh: : 我甚至把你带到了这个极其特别的地方……跟我一起见证一件极其特别的事。

lines.en: : The view up here is unlike anything you’ve ever seen, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这儿的景色跟你见过的任何东西都不一样，对吧？

lines.en: : It reminds me of the end of the world, actually.
lines.zh: : 说实话，它让我想起世界末日。

lines.en: I might as well say that much since there’s no way she’d ever believe me to begin with.
lines.zh: 反正她怎么都不会信我，我不如就说到这个程度。

lines.en: scene bluejay23
: The end of the world?
lines.zh: : 世界末日？

lines.en: : Not the actual end of the world. Just some dream I had.
lines.zh: : 不是真的世界末日。只是我做过的一个梦。

lines.en: : A dream where, at the end of the[school] year, everyone disappeared and I was left to wander the streets alone.
lines.zh: : 一个梦：在[school]年结束的时候，所有人都消失了，只剩我一个人在街上徘徊。

lines.en: : Having no idea what else to do, I turned to {s}God{/s} god. Something I’d never even consider doing under normal circumstances.
lines.zh: : 不知道还能干什么，我转向了「{s}God{/s} god」。正常情况下我绝不会考虑这种事。

lines.en: : In the end, I found myself in a place just like this, looking up at this same sky and thinking about how there isn’t anything like it anywhere else.
lines.zh: : 最后，我发现自己就在一个像这样的地方，抬头看着这片同样的天空，想着世上再没有别处有这种东西。

lines.en: : That doesn’t mean I enjoy it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这不代表我喜欢它。

lines.en: : You really have dreams like that?
lines.zh: : 你真的会做那样的梦？

lines.en: No.
lines.zh: 不。

lines.en: But you don’t need to know that.
lines.zh: 但你不需要知道这个。

lines.en: scene bluejay24
: I guess I have to tell you a dream of mine in return then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那我想我也得告诉你一个我的梦作为回礼了，是吧？

lines.en: : If you want. It’s up to you.
lines.zh: : 如果你想。随你。

lines.en: : Don’t get {i}too{/i} excited, now.
lines.zh: : 现在先别{i}太{/i}兴奋。

lines.en: scene bluejay25
: I’ve been having this one dream reoccur for pretty much my entire life, so I guess it would be easier for both of us if I just told you that one.
lines.zh: : 这个梦我几乎一辈子都在反复做，所以我想我直接告诉你那个，对咱俩都省事。

lines.en: : I’m together with my dad on a raincloud and we both have fishing rods.
lines.zh: : 我和我爸在一朵雨云上，我俩都拿着鱼竿。

lines.en: : Every thirty seconds, the cloud would empty itself out and, mixed in with all of the rainwater, were these rainbow colored fish.
lines.zh: : 每隔三十秒，云就会把自己倒空一次，而在所有雨水混在一起的，是那些彩虹色的鱼。

lines.en: : My dad was great at catching them. But no matter how hard I tried to catch my own, the line would keep snapping whenever I hooked one.
lines.zh: : 我爸很会钓。但不管我怎么努力想钓到自己的那条，每次一上钩，线就会断。

lines.en: : At first I thought it was because I was too weak or inexperienced, but what I figured out after continuing to see the same dream for years and years is that-
lines.zh: : 一开始我以为是太弱或者太没经验，可这个梦年复一年地做下来，我弄明白的是——

lines.en: : Well-
: It’s just a dream.
lines.zh: : 那只是个梦。

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 它不重要。

lines.en: : There are no rain clouds you can fish off of and there are no rainbow colored fish that drop out of them.
lines.zh: : 没有能让你在上面钓鱼的雨云，也没有从云里掉出来的彩虹色的鱼。

lines.en: : And now that my dad's out there among those stars, every aspect of that dream is just...that and nothing else.
lines.zh: : 而现在，我爸就在那些星星之间，那个梦的每一个侧面都只是……如此而已，没有别的。

lines.en: : It's all just a dream.
lines.zh: : 一切只是个梦。

lines.en: : But, my God, do I get excited every time I hear his laugh when he hooks one of those fish.
lines.zh: : 可是，我的天哪，每次听到他钓上鱼时的笑声，我有多兴奋啊。

lines.en: : Even if it’s just a dream...that sound is so...fucking real.
lines.zh: : 哪怕只是个梦……那个声音是那么……他妈的真实。

lines.en: : My dream was cooler.
lines.zh: : 我的梦更酷。

lines.en: scene bluejay26
: Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……

lines.en: : There you go always knowing exactly what to say to girls again.
lines.zh: : 你又来了，总是知道该对女孩说什么。

lines.en: : Maybe one day, I’ll be having dreams about you, too.
lines.zh: : 也许有一天，我也会做关于你的梦。

lines.en: : I’m not much of a fisherman, so try to have dreams about us doing something different.
lines.zh: : 我不太会钓鱼，所以尽量梦到我们干点别的。

lines.en: : Like...racecar driving.
lines.zh: : 比如……开赛车。

lines.en: : I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 我看看能怎么办。

lines.en: scene bluejay27
: Can I...make a request from {i}you{/i}, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我能……向{i}你{/i}提一个请求吗，老师？

lines.en: : Since you’re now in my dream-queue, it seems only fair that I get to ask something of you in return.
lines.zh: : 既然你现在进了我的做梦排队名单，作为回报我提点要求似乎也很公平。

lines.en: : You’re just going to ask me to kiss you, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你只是要我吻你，对吧？

lines.en: : What gives you that idea?
lines.zh: : 你哪来的这个想法？

lines.en: : Well...we haven’t kissed yet. And this seems like it's probably the best opportunity we’ll ever have for our first one.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们还没接过吻。而这看起来大概是我们能有的最好的初吻机会。

lines.en: : Hahah~ It kind of does...doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哈哈～ 好像是……是吧？

lines.en: Makoto pauses and stares so deeply into my eyes that it’s almost like she's seeing through me.
lines.zh: Makoto 停下来，深深地盯着我的眼睛，那眼神几乎像是看穿了我。

lines.en: I’m not sure what’s taking her so long to ask, but I already know what’s coming.
lines.zh: 我不知道她为什么迟迟不开口，但我已经知道接下来是什么了。

lines.en: It’s just a matter of her following through, I guess.
lines.zh: 我想，就只是等她真的做出来而已。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : Close your eyes...
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛……

lines.en: : Really? I don’t even get to see?
lines.zh: : 真的？我连看都不能看？

lines.en: : Sometimes, you can see more with your eyes closed.
lines.zh: : 有时候，闭上眼睛反而能看得更多。

lines.en: I feel like I’ve heard that somewhere before.
lines.zh: 我觉得我在哪儿听过这句话。

lines.en: But where?
lines.zh: 可是在哪儿呢？

lines.en: : Fine. If that’s what you want.
lines.zh: : 好吧。如果那是你要的。

lines.en: scene black
I close my eyes and wait for Makoto to go in for the kill.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，等 Makoto 上来给我致命一击。

lines.en: A second or two later, I can feel her fingers begin to play with locks of my hair as her hand rests atop my head...
lines.zh: 一两秒之后，我感觉到她的手指开始拨弄我的一绺头发，另一只手搭在我头顶……

lines.en: scene bluejay28
: Just so you know, closing your eyes was only the first part of my request.
lines.zh: : 先说明一下，闭上眼睛只是我请求的第一部分。

lines.en: : The second part will be a little more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 第二部分会比那个复杂一点。

lines.en: : You see, Sensei-
lines.zh: : 你看，老师——

lines.en: : I need you to forget everything we said to each other tonight.
lines.zh: : 我需要你忘掉我们今晚对彼此说的一切。

lines.en: : And everything we said to each other before that.
lines.zh: : 以及在那之前对彼此说的一切。

lines.en: : Because, a few minutes ago, when you were talking about that dream you had-
lines.zh: : 因为，几分钟前，当你说起你做的那个梦的时候——

lines.en: : I finally saw a light.
lines.zh: : 我终于看见了一道光。

lines.en: : I can claw my way out of the darkness now.
lines.zh: : 我现在能自己从黑暗里爬出来了。

lines.en: : And it’s all thanks to you.
lines.zh: : 而这一切都多亏了你。

lines.en: : You’ve done so much for me.
lines.zh: : 你为我做了那么多。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry I have to go and ruin it all.
lines.zh: : 而我很抱歉，我得去把这一切毁掉。

lines.en: scene bluejay29
: Here’s hoping you can forgive me.
lines.zh: : 希望你能原谅我。

lines.en: : See you.
lines.zh: : 再见。

scene bluejay36
: Huh?
: Makoto?
lines.zh: : Makoto？

lines.en: scene bluejay37
: What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？

lines.en: : You said you were going to ask me for something and all you’ve done is just-
lines.zh: : 你说你要向我提个请求，而你做的一切就只是——

lines.en: : Wait, are you crying?
lines.zh: : 等等，你在哭吗？

lines.en: scene bluejay38
: But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Okay. You know what? I think it’s time to get you out of here.
lines.zh: : 好吧。你知道吗？我觉得该把你从这儿弄走了。

lines.en: : Y-Yeah...
: That’s...probably good...
lines.zh: : 那……大概挺好……

lines.en: : I’m not feeling well all of a sudden...
lines.zh: : 我突然不太舒服……

lines.en: scene black
I take Makoto’s hand as soon as she makes it down the ladder.
lines.zh: 等 Makoto 从梯子上下来，我立刻握住她的手。

lines.en: She refuses to let go the entire way home.
lines.zh: 回家的路上她一直不肯松开。

lines.en: I’m not sure what it is about her current situation that’s getting her down so badly, but I’m sure she’ll find her way out of it soon enough.
lines.zh: 我不确定她现在的处境里到底是什么让她这么低落，但我确信她很快就能走出来。

lines.en: After all, her problems aren’t nearly as bad as they are for some of the others.
lines.zh: 毕竟，她的问题远没有其他一些人的那么糟。

lines.en: I’m sure she’s fine.
lines.zh: 我确信她没事。
